contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) carries the filer's typed words 'None so far' in the Date column and no other ink -- an EMPTY SCHEDULE, zero rows. 'None so far' is a WORDED nil statement, not a numeral, so it is recorded here rather than treated as a row. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $0' and 'Total Contributions Received $ 0'; Summary p4 Box B = 0 and Box C = 0. B == C so period and cumulative coincide.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p3) carries a single '0' in the Date column and no other ink -- empty schedule, zero rows. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 0' and 'Total Expenditures Made $ 0'; Summary p4 Box D = 0 and Box E = 0. Period and cumulative coincide.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows-sum 0 = printed subtotal 0 = printed total 0. p3 rows-sum 0 = printed subtotal 0 = printed total 0. Both gate exactly.
gates.row_count: Born-digital pdf-lib rendering with NO printed row rules on either schedule (rowbands.py has no grid to score). Counted by ink and cross-checked against the PDF's embedded text layer: p2 returns one token line ('None so far') and p3 one token line ('0') between the column header and the footer block; neither is a transaction, so 0 rows emitted on each side.
gates.geometry_proof: Not applicable -- zero rows emitted on both sides, so no row geometry is claimed.
gates.balance_chain: Summary p4: A=0, B=0, C=0, D=0, E=0, F=0, Balance at Close=0. 0 + 0 - 0 = 0 closes exactly.

escalation_note: No escalation needed: born-digital typed zeros, unambiguous at 200 dpi.
notes: BLANK OFFICE LINE AT THE PAGE -- index.csv says 'County Council' but the cover's Office box is EMPTY (the filer wrote nothing in it). This is one of the county's known honest blank-office states, so the money is transcribed normally and the blank is recorded rather than filled from the index; scope was therefore judged on the FORM'S OWN TITLE plus the fact that the filing is in the county's county-office CFD channel, and nothing in the document names a school-board or municipal seat. A human should confirm the seat from another source before the office is published for this filing. DATE DISAGREES WITH THE CHUNK FILE: the chunk says 2026-03-11; the form's Date, its three 'Date of Report' footers and the 'Signed at: 2026-03-10 21:11:57' stamp all read 03-10-2026. Transcribed from the form. REPORT TYPE: none of the three printed radios is marked; the filer typed the free-text line '7 days prior to the convention' instead. Candidate home street address, phone and email printed in the clear on the cover were discarded at read time.
